scientific_question: Is the already-present correctness-aligned first-order fast-weight response sufficient for local fidelity when its component lost by exact finite-amplitude expression is explicitly restored at the policy margin?
core_hypothesis: The frozen seed-2101 fast-weight substrate already supplies both global assembly and a correctness-aligned J_b u response. Human-like local fidelity may require preserving the difference between this first-order response and the exact finite-amplitude tanh response at policy expression, without changing recurrent computation, storage, or readout parameters.
mechanism_family: low-capacity first-order response-expression correction, distinct from scalar input-amplitude gating
claim_boundary: This is a one-backbone, one-parameter development sufficiency test. It does not confirm population-level v2, introduce a second memory store, identify a biological residual pathway, change tanh, fit a new readout, or permit Liu-informed adaptation. A valid failure closes the family in which the existing first-order signal can be recovered by a low-capacity response-expression correction; it does not erase the supported fast-weight global mechanism.
registration_timing: The contract is frozen after the policy-opposition v2.1 pilot validly closed scalar amplitude gating and before writing the v2.2 implementation, adapting eta, constructing Liu controls, or evaluating any v2.2 condition.

frozen_backbone_contract.origin: final step-1000 v1 backbone produced under curvature_gate_pilot_v2
frozen_backbone_contract.reuse_only: Do not retrain or edit the backbone. Freeze every backbone tensor before v2.2 eta adaptation and verify byte identity afterward.

execution_contract.device: visible CUDA GPU required for eta adaptation and neural replay
execution_contract.trial_input_transfer: one contiguous CPU-to-GPU transfer per trial
execution_contract.implementation_freeze: The v2.2 implementation, tests, and implementation lock must be committed after this protocol and before eta adaptation.
execution_contract.artifact_freeze: After eta adaptation, write and commit a separate artifact lock containing the exact eta-artifact hash before any Liu evaluation. Evaluation must refuse artifact, backbone, protocol, or source mismatches.
execution_contract.seed_subject_relation_or_trial_filtering: forbidden except the prospectively defined stable-omission retained-evidence mask

policy_residual_equation.scope: only the two choice logits at the first fast-weight-sensitive response transition; hidden activation, value, DA, eligibility, fast weights, support dynamics, and all backbone parameters remain exact frozen v1
policy_residual_equation.first_order_response_increment: delta_h_lin = J_b u = (1 - tanh(b)^2) elementwise-multiplied by u
policy_residual_equation.symmetric_logit_implementation: output_eta[class_0] = output_v1[class_0] - eta c_res / 2 and output_eta[class_1] = output_v1[class_1] + eta c_res / 2, preserving common-mode logit and changing the margin by exactly eta c_res
policy_residual_equation.hidden_policy_equivalence: Because W_out is linear at this choice step, applying the same scalar eta to delta_h_exact + eta(delta_h_lin-delta_h_exact) in hidden space gives the same policy margin. Only the policy form is tested; hidden and policy forms are not separate candidates.
policy_residual_equation.eta_constraint: eta = sigmoid(raw_eta), raw_eta is the only trainable v2.2 parameter, and 0 <= eta <= 1
policy_residual_equation.eta_zero_identity: eta=0 exactly reproduces all v1 outputs and recurrent state
policy_residual_equation.eta_one_identity: eta=1 replaces only the fast-weight-induced policy increment by its current-operating-point first-order expression
policy_residual_equation.online_inputs_only: P_T, current query-derived h0, x_response, and frozen backbone parameters including W_margin
policy_residual_equation.forbidden_inputs: relation identity, H>A indicator, true label, correctness, LOO state, posterior, subject identifier, offline crossing, Liu-derived statistic, or a newly fitted readout

eta_only_adaptation.backbone: load the frozen seed-2101 checkpoint and freeze every v1 parameter
eta_only_adaptation.task_distribution: the same generic sparse ranking distribution with the Liu graph and its rank-axis reflection excluded
eta_only_adaptation.loss: mean generic query cross-entropy under the natural policy residual; no Liu term, human scalar, relation label, crossing target, or auxiliary residual target
eta_only_adaptation.control_training: none; both controls reuse the exact candidate-trained eta and add no parameter

liu_evaluation.randomness_reuse_rationale: Reuse the frozen v2 Liu evaluation draws to isolate the expression mechanism; none enter eta adaptation.

conditions.original_v1: eta=0 with the frozen seed-2101 backbone
conditions.policy_residual: apply the natural online c_res with generic-only adapted eta
conditions.matched_magnitude_null: apply c_null = sigma_subject_query |c_res| with the same eta; for each subject, a fixed seeded permutation assigns exactly 28 positive and 28 negative signs across the 56 canonical oriented queries, and intact plus every LOO replay reuse the same sign table
conditions.shuffled_residual: within each subject, permute signed c_res across the 56 canonical oriented queries; intact and every relation-LOO replay use the same query permutation, preserving each replay's correction distribution while breaking state-query matching

estimand_contract.local_field: For each retained support relation q, subtract relation-LOO logits from intact logits on all 28 pairs in both orientations, antisymmetrize, and apply the complete-graph Hodge residual projector.
estimand_contract.direct_correctness: Multiply the Hodge residual on q's direct edge by the registered correct orientation sign.
primary_local_estimands: within-subject mean direct correctness over the other seven retained relations
estimand_contract.remote_reassembly: For each retained q, average absolute intact-minus-LOO influence over disjoint query pairs and average within subject before bootstrap.
estimand_contract.third_party_reassembly: Use the gauge-invariant third-party relational potential-energy fraction from the registered assembly definition and average retained relations within subject.
estimand_contract.query_binding: Matched normalized operator-action gain minus shared-endpoint mismatch and disjoint mismatch, using the registered state-query operator definition before policy residual expression.
estimand_contract.terminal_projection: Policy-residual final neural-potential cosine to exact posterior expected-rank/Hodge potential minus cosine to exact MAP potential.
estimand_contract.residual_allocation: Report c_res, eta c_res, and control corrections by relation including H>A and F>A, plus their subject-query distributions. These are mechanistic diagnostics and do not replace causal outcome rules.
estimand_contract.behavioral_consequences: Report learned accuracy, nonlearned accuracy, overall accuracy, and symbolic-distance slope for all four conditions; no human interval is a primary gate.

competence_and_integrity_gates.backbone: The original-v1 condition must pass qualification_v2 before the residual result is interpreted.
competence_and_integrity_gates.source_and_artifact_hashes: Every registered source, implementation source, backbone checkpoint, eta artifact, and artifact lock must match its recorded SHA-256.
competence_and_integrity_gates.frozen_backbone: Only raw_eta may change during adaptation; every v1 state-dict tensor must be byte-identical before and after.
competence_and_integrity_gates.eta_zero_equivalence: original_v1 must reproduce ungated backbone logits and all recurrent outputs exactly, with logit tolerance at most 1e-6.
competence_and_integrity_gates.policy_residual_identity: For every evaluated natural candidate state, corrected margin minus v1 margin must equal eta c_res within 1e-6.
competence_and_integrity_gates.matched_magnitude_integrity: For every subject, query, intact state, and LOO replay, |c_null| must equal |c_res| within 1e-7; each subject sign table has exactly 28 positive and 28 negative entries and is reused across intact and LOO.
competence_and_integrity_gates.shuffle_integrity: Shuffled c_res must preserve each subject and replay's 56-value multiset within 1e-7 and change at least one assignment for every nonconstant row.
competence_and_integrity_gates.stable_omission: Relation-LOO influence and direct correctness must be zero within 1e-7 when the relation was already omitted.
competence_and_integrity_gates.control_parameter_integrity: Both controls use the same frozen eta as the natural candidate and introduce no trainable parameter.

primary_decision_rules.local_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for policy-residual minus original retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
primary_decision_rules.H_greater_A_rescue: The paired retained-subject bootstrap lower bound for policy-residual minus original H>A direct correctness exceeds zero, and H>A under policy residual is not robustly wrong-sign: its bootstrap upper bound is at least zero.
primary_decision_rules.preserve_other_relations: The policy-residual-minus-original mean over the other seven retained relations has a paired-bootstrap lower bound no smaller than -0.01.
primary_decision_rules.control_specificity: Each paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for policy residual minus matched-magnitude null and policy residual minus shuffled residual retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
primary_decision_rules.nonlearned_preservation: Policy-residual nonlearned accuracy is at least 0.70 and no more than 0.02 below original v1.
primary_decision_rules.fast_weight_necessity: The policy-residual condition passes every qualification_v2 intervention and order-invariance rule.
primary_decision_rules.global_reassembly_preservation: Policy-residual remote absolute and third-party relational estimands each have bootstrap lower bounds above zero and point estimates at least 80 percent of original v1.
primary_decision_rules.query_binding_preservation: Both policy-residual matched-minus-mismatch normalized operator-gain contrasts remain positive and equal original within 1e-7 because this estimand precedes policy correction.
primary_decision_rules.terminal_projection_preservation: The policy-residual expected-rank-minus-MAP participant-bootstrap lower bound exceeds zero.

outcome_contingent_interpretation.all_primary_rules_pass: Explicitly restoring the existing first-order residual is sufficient on the frozen seed-2101 backbone. The same synaptic operator can support an exact nonlinear global branch and a preserved first-order local-fidelity expression regime. Freeze a separate 2102/2103 replication contract before any new seed or end-to-end training.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.valid_local_or_specificity_failure: Close the entire family in which the existing first-order signal is recoverable by a low-capacity response-expression correction. Do not invent additional residual scalars, train on Liu, change tanh, or run 2102/2103. The next justified family is a separately persistent local component, prospectively registered on the same backbone before any implementation.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.local_rescue_with_global_failure: Reject the candidate because it trades the supported global mechanism for local fidelity; close low-capacity response-expression correction and move to a separately persistent local component.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.competence_or_integrity_failure: The mechanistic outcome is non-interpretable; repair execution on the same frozen backbone without changing equations, controls, thresholds, seeds, or scientific rules.
